House.text: Introduction and first reading, referred to Public Safety Finance and Policy

bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to public safety; providing that the discharge papers of a veteran are considered the legal equivalent of a permit to carry a firearm; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 624.714, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 624.714, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 25.+]

[+Military discharge papers; equivalent to permit to carry.+]

[+Notwithstanding any provision in this section or other law to the contrary, a veteran, as defined in section 197.447, may carry a pistol as provided in this subdivision under any circumstances and in any location in which a permit to carry is otherwise required. The veteran must possess the original or a certified copy of the veteran's government form DD214 while carrying the pistol. This form constitutes the legal equivalency of a permit to carry. The veteran is not required to apply for a permit to carry, pay any fees, or demonstrate training in the safe use of a pistol. All other provisions of this section and other laws relating to permits to carry pistols apply to a veteran carrying under this subdivision. +]
